update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.8 - Parent Farming Skill Point Check fix
Fixed ----- - Enabling "Skill Point Check" (and its buy-and-continue plan) in Skills settings had no effect while Parent Farming Mode was on: the parent-farming settings resolver unconditionally forced the toggle back off before it ever reached the bot, so the log reported it disabled even though the app showed it enabled. The toggle is now only forced off when its Skill Point Check plan isn't also enabled (in which case enabling it alone would just stop the bot, which still doesn't make sense for an unattended farming run) — otherwise your configured mid-run skill purchase now actually happens. - Added a "Skill Point Check Plan" line to the settings log banner (matching the existing Pre-Finals/CareerComplete lines) so its enabled state and configuration are visible going forward.
